'''Rod Latham Walker Garrison''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst3.htm Walker Garrison], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183515/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst3.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Event:''' [[1998 Shawn Valdez Tournament]]
* '''Played:''' August 1998

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 29th August 1998, 2 wins and 0 losses from 2 games (differential +13).<ref name="trandosite" />
